subcategory_text: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-04, PM-06, RA-07, SR-06
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 9.1, Annex A.5.1, Annex A.5.19, Annex A.5.20
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.OV-03, GV.OV-03.01, GV.OV-03.02
implementation_examples: Review key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure that organization-wide policies and procedures achieve objectives
Review key risk indicators (KRIs) to identify risks the organization faces, including likelihood and potential impact
Collect and communicate metrics on cybersecurity risk management with senior leadership
assessment_objectives: Determine whether organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed.
Determine whether activities are conducted to review key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure that organization-wide policies and procedures achieve objectives.
Determine whether activities are conducted to review key risk indicators (KRIs) to identify risks the organization faces, including likelihood and potential impact.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
